fixes.what: EXIT gains 'act-due': 17 (CONTRACT 1.4, modelfix-U1). paths(root).scripts = <root>/tcb (flat layout). parseTranscript tool results get a non-enumerable `urls` (distinct http(s) URLs of the FULL result text, at most 500, trailing punctuation dropped), so R34 evidence past the 2,000-character cut is kept (fix-U2).
urlEvidence also uses each fetch/search/agent result's `urls` (fix-U2). Command-line comments now say tcb/<name>.mjs.
The tcb-node Bash rule is now `node tcb/<name>.mjs` (not lib.mjs), the same rule guard-hook uses. It was the prefix 'node tcb/scripts/'.

E2E failure 2: an Agent/Task result written in prose is no longer a candidate (spec 'Candidates': only text that parses whole as JSON). Text that starts with { or [ and does not parse still counts as unparseable. A normal session now exits 0.

E2E failure 1: new optional case field `git: true`. It makes the case root a git repo whose one commit holds the case's tcb/, and sets run/coord.json tcb_commit to that commit. Git runs one call at a time, with no shell, no hooks and no global or system config. Without this, no fsck case can exit 0.

E2E failure 1: 19 new synthetic cases, at least one good and one bad per script. status: meter good, pct 66, stale-ce 64. watch: once good, stale-ce 64. handover: init good, bad commit 66, raise stale-ce 64. harvest: reader card good (file sha checked), invalid card 1, no-session 2. commit: harvested intake good, no-task 1, stale-epoch 65, seed-id 3. fsck: good (git), object-mismatch 3 (git and no git), no-coordinator 2.
E2E failure 4: the file now ships, with comments only. audit's 'absent file = empty list' rule is kept because spec/audit T9 states it.
Checking whether a holder is alive now uses the one-sided start-time rule of lib.aliveFromQuery instead of the symmetric sameStartTime (lib-fix LR-2).
{{role}} renders the control role as 'solo' in the brief (U5-B-1). The manifest keeps the real role.
node tcb/scripts/<name>.mjs changed to node tcb/<name>.mjs.
Bash commands moved to the flat layout. The assertions are unchanged.
T6 now uses an Agent result with broken JSON (unparseable 2 and exit 1 are still asserted). It adds a prose result and asserts candidates 2, so the test is stricter, not weaker.

New tests: T76b (urls past the cut), commit T6b (a URL past the cut is accepted, a URL in no result is still rejected), replace T13b (the control brief says 'role solo' and never 'control'; the manifest keeps role control).
The harvest steps now require exit 0 instead of also accepting exit 1.

Step 5: every tcb/scripts/ path now reads tcb/ (flat layout; scripts find lib, schemas and siblings through import.meta.url). The coordinator Bash rule is now `node tcb/<name>.mjs` (not lib.mjs). guard-hook T5 now names the old layout as refused.

lib_changes: parseTranscript: each toolResults entry gets a non-enumerable `urls` (URLs of the full result text, at most 500, trailing .,;:!? dropped). `text` is still cut at 2,000 characters.

Not applied: widening the fence() READY re-check to every reason except first/tainted (modelfix-U1 M6). spec/lib T56 says failure reasons only, and replace.mjs already makes the wider check under the same lock.
First-run requests (TcbError, runMain mode/dry_run, withRunLock retries, objectId prefixes, helpers.mjs, imports) were already handled by the lib stages; everything runs against the current lib.
